Traspaso de estudio de diseño totalmente reformado para entrar a trabajar.

Design studio for lease, fully renovated and ready to move in.
Ideal studio for an interior designer, architects, clothing store, jewelry shop, design workshop, hair salon, or nail salon.
Located in the El Viso area, a commercial street with high foot traffic, schools, and trendy bars.

Contact via WhatsApp.
